name: Item trackers
source: Bluetooth SIG 16-bit UUID member registry, verified 2026-10-31. The rule engine only uses unambiguous accessory service UUIDs for broad UI labelling; TrackerParser is authoritative for manufacturer payloads and shared UUIDs, including Google FMDN versus Eddystone (state, battery, DULT).

rules.label: Apple Find My
rules.note: Find My Network accessory service 0xFD44. Apple company ID 0x004C alone is intentionally insufficient; ordinary Apple devices use it too.
